reason: A proposes an actual material-restoring intervention—low-heat-input laser cladding with an HEA overlay—and a direct comparison under thermal-mechanical service cycling, whereas B’s FSP may not fill lost material and its fine-grain refinement could impair high-temperature creep performance. A remains underspecified in composition, process window, and quantitative acceptance criteria, and its cited evidence supports coating feasibility and wear more than hot-crack-resistant structural repair, but it is still the more relevant and testable proposal.
